title: 定语从句：限定与非限定

markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 定语从句分两种：**限定的**帮你挑出「是哪一个」，去掉就不知道说谁；**非限定的**只是「顺便补一句」，前后有逗号，去掉了意思还完整。

uses.zh: 挑出是哪一个（没有逗号）
uses.en: The colleague [[who]] sits next to me is from Leeds.
uses.en_zh: 坐我旁边的那个同事是利兹人。

uses.en: My manager, [[who]] is from Leeds, loves tea.
uses.en_zh: 我的经理是利兹人，特别爱喝茶。

uses.en: The release was delayed, [[which]] annoyed everyone.
uses.en_zh: 发布推迟了，这让大家都很恼火。

defining.title: 限定：挑出是哪一个
defining.rule: **没有逗号**。去掉这句，听的人就不知道你说的是哪一个。可以用 that；后面紧跟另一个人时，who / which / that 还能省掉。

examples.en: The tests [[that]] failed last night are all UI tests.
examples.zh: 昨晚失败的那些测试都是 UI 测试。

examples.en: The designer [[who]] made our icons is leaving.
examples.zh: 做我们图标的那位设计师要走了。

examples.en: The ticket ([[that]]) you opened is a duplicate.
examples.zh: 你开的那个工单是重复的。

defining.tip: 试试去掉它：「The designer is leaving.」哪个设计师？说不清 → 这就是限定的。

nonDefining.title: 非限定：顺便补一句
nonDefining.rule: 前后用**逗号**隔开，像括号里的悄悄话。说的人或东西大家已经知道是谁了。**不能用 that，也不能省掉 who / which。**

examples.en: My sister, [[who]] lives in Bristol, is a nurse.
examples.zh: 我姐姐住在布里斯托尔，她是护士。

examples.en: Swift, [[which]] Apple released in 2014, is easy to read.
examples.zh: Swift 是苹果在 2014 年发布的，读起来很容易。

examples.en: Our CTO, [[whose]] office is upstairs, wants a demo.
examples.zh: 我们的 CTO 想看个演示，他办公室在楼上。

wrong.bad: Our app, ~~that~~ has two million users, is free.
wrong.good: Our app, [[which]] has two million users, is free.

notes: 人名、my mum、London 这种本来就只有一个的，后面的从句几乎都是非限定的，要加逗号。

whichWhole.title: which 指前面一整件事
whichWhole.rule: 句子最后加「, which …」，which 可以指**前面整件事**，意思像「这件事」，中文常说「这让……」「这挺……」。

examples.en: The build failed again, [[which]] was annoying.
He fixed it in ten minutes, [[which]] surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他十分钟就修好了，大家都很惊讶。

examples.en: We finished early, [[which]] meant we could go home.
examples.zh: 我们提前做完了，所以能回家了。

notes: 这种用法只能用 which，不能用 what 或 that，前面一定有逗号。

reduce.title: 把定语从句变短
reduce.rule: 定语从句可以「压缩」：主动的 who / which + 动词，变成 **-ing**；被动的 which is + done，只留 **done**。意思不变，说起来更利落。

items.en: The man [[talking]] to Sam is our new PM.
items.zh: 正在和 Sam 说话的那个人是我们的新项目经理。

items.rule: 被动 → 过去分词（= which were reported）
items.en: The bugs [[reported]] last week are all fixed.
items.zh: 上周报上来的 bug 都修好了。

items.en: Anyone [[wanting]] a ticket should email me.
items.zh: 想要票的人给我发邮件。

items.rule: first、last、only 后面 → to + 动词
items.en: She was the first person [[to reply]].

contrast.title: 有逗号和没逗号比一比

this.meaning: 没逗号：我有好几个兄弟，说的是住伦敦的那个
this.en: My brother [[who]] lives in London is a doctor.

that.meaning: 有逗号：我只有一个兄弟，顺便说他住伦敦
that.en: My brother, [[who]] lives in London, is a doctor.

this.meaning: 没逗号：只有知道 bug 的那几个人修了
this.en: The developers [[who]] knew about the bug fixed it.

that.meaning: 有逗号：开发们都知道，也都修了
that.en: The developers, [[who]] knew about the bug, fixed it.

commonMistakes.bad: London, ~~that~~ is my favourite city, is expensive.
commonMistakes.good: London, [[which]] is my favourite city, is expensive.

commonMistakes.bad: My mum, ~~is~~ a teacher, loves books.
commonMistakes.good: My mum, [[who]] is a teacher, loves books.
commonMistakes.why: 有逗号的 who / which 不能省。

commonMistakes.bad: It rained all day, ~~what~~ ruined our picnic.
commonMistakes.good: It rained all day, [[which]] ruined our picnic.
commonMistakes.why: 指前面整件事用 which，不用 what。

commonMistakes.bad: The man ~~talked~~ to Sam is our PM.
commonMistakes.good: The man [[talking]] to Sam is our PM.

quiz.prompt: 哪一句是「顺便补一句」的非限定从句？
options: My manager, who is from Leeds, loves tea.
The man who called you is here.
The tests that failed are UI tests.
quiz.answer: My manager, who is from Leeds, loves tea.
quiz.explain: 有逗号、去掉还完整的是非限定。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我姐姐住在布里斯托尔，她是护士。（用 who）
quiz.answer: My sister, who lives in Bristol, is a nurse.
accept: My sister, who is a nurse, lives in Bristol.
My sister, who's a nurse, lives in Bristol.

quiz.prompt: The tests ___ failed last night are all UI tests.
quiz.explain: 没逗号，挑出是哪些测试，用 [[that]]。

quiz.prompt: 哪一句里的关系词可以省掉？
options: The ticket that you opened is a duplicate.
My sister, who you met, is a nurse.
The man who called is here.
quiz.answer: The ticket that you opened is a duplicate.
quiz.explain: 限定从句，后面紧跟 you，可以省。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Our app, that has two million users, is free.
quiz.answer: Our app, which has two million users, is free.
quiz.explain: 有逗号的不能用 that，换成 [[which]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 who 合成一句：My manager loves tea. She is from Leeds.
quiz.answer: My manager, who is from Leeds, loves tea.
accept: My manager, who's from Leeds, loves tea.
quiz.explain: 经理只有一个，用逗号把 [[who]] is from Leeds 插进去。

quiz.prompt: Our CTO, ___ office is upstairs, wants a demo.
The build failed again, ___ was annoying.
用 which 合成一句：He fixed it in ten minutes. That surprised everyone.
quiz.answer: He fixed it in ten minutes, which surprised everyone.

quiz.prompt: 变短：The man who is talking to Sam is our new PM.
quiz.answer: The man talking to Sam is our new PM.

quiz.prompt: The bugs ___ (report) last week are all fixed.

traps.note: bug 不会自己报，是被报的，用 reported。

quiz.explain: bug 是「被报的」，只留过去分词 [[reported]]。

quiz.prompt: She was the first person ___ (reply) to my email.
「我只有一个兄弟，顺便说他住伦敦」应该说：
options: My brother who lives in London is a doctor.
My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.
quiz.answer: My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.
quiz.explain: 只有一个，是顺便补充，要加逗号。

quiz.prompt: 改错：It rained all day, what ruined our picnic.
quiz.answer: It rained all day, which ruined our picnic.

quiz.prompt: 改错：My mum, is a teacher, loves books.
quiz.answer: My mum, who is a teacher, loves books.
accept: My mum, who's a teacher, loves books.
My mum, a teacher, loves books.

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话介绍你的城市、团队或一个 App：一句用限定从句（没逗号），一句用非限定从句（有逗号），一句用「, which …」评论前面整件事。
rules: 有逗号的从句不用 that，也不省 who / which
openTask.note: 规则判逗号和 that / which 用法（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
